aifin.title: Finance assistant
aifin.lead: Understand the month at a glance, get practical suggestions and ask questions about your clinic's figures.
aifin.disclaimer: Suggestions are generated by AI from your clinic's aggregated figures. They are management guidance only — not accounting, tax, legal or investment advice. Check important decisions with your accountant.
aifin.off_title: The finance assistant is not available
aifin.analysis_sub: Summary, strengths, warnings and next steps for the selected month.
aifin.no_analysis_title: No analysis for this month yet
aifin.no_analysis_text: The assistant reviews this month's revenue, expenses, payroll and appointments, compares them with the previous month and suggests next steps.
aifin.no_analysis_off: The figures above are always available. The AI analysis appears here once the finance assistant is switched on.
aifin.analyse_hint: Only totals are sent — no patient information.
aifin.analysing: Analysing… this can take up to a minute
aifin.breakdown_sub: The same figures the assistant works with.
aifin.chat_sub: Questions about revenue, expenses, doctors and bookings. It can prepare an expense or a supplier for you to confirm.
aifin.usage_title: AI requests used by the clinic this month
aifin.clear_confirm: Clear this conversation? Actions waiting for confirmation will be cancelled.
aifin.chat_off: The chat becomes available once the finance assistant is switched on for your role.
aifin.welcome: Ask about this month's results, compare periods, or ask me to record an expense — nothing is saved until you confirm.

suggest.s1: Why did expenses change compared with last month?
suggest.s2: Which doctor brought the most revenue this month?
suggest.s4: Record 45 for cleaning supplies today, paid in cash

aifin.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
aifin.action_hint: Prepared by the assistant — review before saving.
aifin.no_perm_add_expense: You need permission to manage expenses to save this.
aifin.no_perm_add_supplier: You need permission to manage supplies to save this.
aifin.saved_by_you: Saved by you from the assistant.
aifin.settings_sub: Monthly analysis and a chat about your clinic's figures for owners, managers and accountants.
aifin.enable: Turn on the finance assistant for this clinic
aifin.enable_help: Allowed staff will see the assistant under Finance. It uses the same monthly request limit as the clinical assistant.
aifin.notice_sent: Aggregated figures only: revenue by payment method and by doctor (doctor names included), discounts, expenses by category and their descriptions, payroll totals, appointment counts, no-show rates and booking sources — sent to Anthropic for processing by Claude.
aifin.notice_not_sent: Patient names, phone numbers, IDs and clinical notes are never sent.
aifin.notice_actions: The assistant can prepare an expense or a supplier, but nothing is saved until the user presses Confirm; the permission is checked at that moment and the action is logged.
aifin.notice_advice: Answers are management guidance, not accounting, tax, legal or investment advice.
aifin.acknowledge: I have read the notice and agree that aggregated financial figures are sent to Anthropic for processing.
aifin.roles_sub: Only roles with access to finance can be chosen.

errors_aifin.AIFIN_CLINIC_OFF: The finance assistant is switched off for this clinic. An administrator can switch it on under Settings → AI assistant.
errors_aifin.AIFIN_NO_PERMISSION: You do not have access to the clinic's finance.
errors_aifin.AI_ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED: Your role is not allowed to use the finance assistant in this clinic.
errors_aifin.AI_REFUSED: The assistant declined this request. Try rephrasing it.
errors_aifin.AI_TRUNCATED: The answer was too long and was cut off. Please try again.
errors_aifin.AIFIN_BUSY: Your previous request is still running. Please wait a moment.
errors_aifin.AIFIN_ACTION_GONE: This action was already confirmed or cancelled.
errors_aifin.AIFIN_ACTION_EXPIRED: This action has expired. Ask the assistant to prepare it again.
errors_aifin.ACTION_INVALID: The data could not be saved:
errors_aifin.ACTION_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to save this. Ask a manager.
